arxiv-2011-07652.title: A single-projection three-dimensional reconstruction algorithm for scanning transmission electron microscopy data
arxiv-2011-07652.creator: Hamish G. Brown, 1 Philipp M. Pelz, 1,2 Shang-Lin Hsu, 1,2 Zimeng Zhang, 2 Ramamoorthy Ramesh, 2,3 Katherine Inzani, 4,5 Evan Sheridan, 4,5,6 Sinéad M. Griffin, 4,5 Marcel Schloz, 7 Thomas C. Pekin, 7 Christoph T. Koch, 7 Scott D. Findlay, 8 Leslie J. Allen, 9 Mary C. Scott, 1,2 Colin Ophus, 1 Jim C
arxiv-2011-07652.description: Abstract Increasing interest in three-dimensional nanostructures adds impetus to electron microscopy techniques capable of imaging at or below the nanoscale in three dimensions. We present a reconstruction algorithm that takes as input a focal series of four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D-STEM) data.

arxiv-2212-12963.title: Anomaly Detection of Underwater Gliders Verified by Deployment Data Thanks: The research work is supported by ONR grants N00014-19-1-2556 and N00014-19-1-2266; AFOSR grant FA9550-19-1-0283; NSF grants GCR-1934836, CNS-2016582 and ITE-2137798; and NOAA grant NA16NOS0120028.
arxiv-2212-12963.creator: Ruochu Yang, Mengxue Hou, Chad Lembke, Catherine Edwards, Fumin Zhang
arxiv-2212-12963.description: Abstract This paper utilizes an anomaly detection algorithm to check if underwater gliders are operating normally in the unknown ocean environment. Glider pilots can be warned of the detected glider anomaly in real time, thus taking over the glider appropriately and avoiding further damage to the glider.

arxiv-2301-00349.title: Towards Reliable Medical Image Segmentation by utilizing Evidential Calibrated Uncertainty Journal: Elsevier
arxiv-2301-00349.creator: Ke Zou, Yidi Chen, Ling Huang, Xuedong Yuan, Xiaojing Shen, Meng Wang, Rick Siow Mong Goh, Yong Liu, Huazhu Fu
arxiv-2301-00349.description: Abstract Medical image segmentation is critical for disease diagnosis and treatment assessment. However, concerns regarding the reliability of segmentation regions persist among clinicians, mainly attributed to the absence of confidence assessment, robustness, and calibration to accuracy. To address this, we introduce DEviS, an easily implementable foundational model that seamlessly integrates into various medical image segmentation networks.

arxiv-2303-17835.title: Improved Difference Images for Change Detection Classifiers in SAR Imagery Using Deep Learning
arxiv-2303-17835.creator: Janne Alatalo, Tuomo Sipola, Mika Rantonen
arxiv-2303-17835.description: Abstract Satellite-based Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) images can be used as a source of remote sensed imagery regardless of cloud cover and day-night cycle. However, the speckle noise and varying image acquisition conditions pose a challenge for change detection classifiers.

arxiv-2404-11161.title: BAHOP: Similarity-based Basin Hopping for A fast hyper-parameter search in WSI classification
arxiv-2404-11161.creator: Jun Wang, Yu Mao, Yufei Cui, Nan Guan, Chun Jason Xue
arxiv-2404-11161.description: Abstract Pre-processing whole slide images (WSIs) can impact classification performance. Our study shows that using fixed hyper-parameters for pre-processing out-of-domain WSIs can significantly degrade performance. Therefore, it is critical to search domain-specific hyper-parameters during inference. However, searching for an optimal parameter set is time-consuming.

arxiv-2404-16047.title: From “AI” to Probabilistic Automation: How Does Anthropomorphization of Technical Systems Descriptions Influence Trust?
arxiv-2404-16047.creator: Nanna Inie, Stefania Druga, Peter Zukerman, Emily M. Bender
arxiv-2404-16047.description: Abstract . This paper investigates the influence of anthropomorphized descriptions of so-called “AI” (artificial intelligence) systems on people’s self-assessment of trust in the system. Building on prior work, we define four categories of anthropomorphization ( 1. Properties of a cognizer , 2. Agency , 3. Biological metaphors , and 4. Properties of a communicator ).

arxiv-2406-02804.title: ACCORD : Closing the Commonsense Measurability Gap
arxiv-2406-02804.creator: François Roewer-Després, Jinyue Feng, Zining Zhu, Frank Rudzicz
arxiv-2406-02804.description: Abstract We present ACCORD , a framework and benchmark suite for disentangling the commonsense grounding and reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs) through controlled, multi-hop counterfactuals. ACCORD introduces formal elements to commonsense reasoning to explicitly control and quantify reasoning complexity beyond the typical 1 or 2 hops.

arxiv-2412-03123.title: Robust Multi-bit Text Watermark with LLM-based Paraphrasers
arxiv-2412-03123.creator: Xiaojun Xu, Jinghan Jia, Yuanshun Yao, Yang Liu, Hang Li
arxiv-2412-03123.description: Abstract We propose an imperceptible multi-bit text watermark embedded by paraphrasing with LLMs. We fine-tune a pair of LLM paraphrasers that are designed to behave differently so that their paraphrasing difference reflected in the text semantics can be identified by a trained decoder.

pmc-10698919.title: Effect of sutureless scleral fixed intraocular lens implantation on aphakic eyes: a system review and meta-analysis
pmc-10698919.creator: Zhao Liu, Qian Xie, XingWang Chen, Bing Xie, ShanJun Cai
pmc-10698919.description: BackgroundSutureless scleral fixed intraocular lens implantation (SF-IOL) has become one of the mainstream schemes in clinical treatment of aphakic eyes because of its advantages, such as avoiding dislocation of intraocular lens or subluxation caused by suture degradation or fracture and significant improvement of postoperative visual acuity.

pmc-11312263.title: Shear-Wave Elastography Gradient Analysis of Newly Diagnosed Breast Tumours: A Critical Analysis
pmc-11312263.creator: Johannes Deeg, Michael Swoboda, Daniel Egle, Verena Wieser, Afschin Soleiman, Valentin Ladenhauf, Malik Galijasevic, Birgit Amort, Leonhard Gruber, Zhuhuang Zhou, Fabiano Bini
pmc-11312263.description: Background: A better understanding of the peritumoral stroma changes due to tumour invasion using non-invasive diagnostic methods may improve the differentiation between benign and malignant breast lesions. This study aimed to assess the correlation between breast lesion differentiation and intra- and peritumoral shear-wave elastography (SWE) gradients. Methods: A total of 135 patients with newly diagnosed breast lesions were included.

pmc-11535998.title: Association between type III collagen degradation and local tissue damage of a single joint
pmc-11535998.creator: Christian S Thudium, Sten Rasmussen, Morten A Karsdal, Anne-Christine Bay-Jensen
pmc-11535998.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). ObjectiveThe development of disease-modifying drugs is limited by OA's heterogeneity and the challenge of defining clinical endpoints. Serological biomarkers are considered potential surrogate endpoints, but their contribution from single joints to systemic levels in OA patients is unclear. In this exploratory study we longitudinally assessed systemic biomarker levels' response to tissue damage and healing before and after surgery in patients undergoing knee or hip joint replacement revision for aseptic failure.

pmc-12386759.title: Gold Nanoparticles as Targeted Drug Delivery Systems for Liver Cancer: A Systematic Review of Tumor Targeting Efficiency and Toxicity Profiles
pmc-12386759.creator: Meda Cosma, Teodora Mocan, Cristian Delcea, Teodora Pop, Ofelia Mosteanu, Lucian Mocan
pmc-12386759.description: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HC) ranks as the fifth most prevalent form of cancer among humans and is a significant contributor to cancer-related deaths. During the latest year, an interesting scientific fascination arose around gold nanoparticles (AUNPs) following the recovery of their remarkable properties. Some studies suggest that AUNPs can enhance drug targeting in cancer treatment and reduce its toxicity.

pmc-12546692.title: Edible insect larvae as sustainable sources of chitosan: Influence of species and drying method on functional and structural properties
pmc-12546692.creator: Ji Yoon Cha, Yea-Ji Kim, Jeong Heon Kim, Dong-Hyun Keum, Jaejoon Han, Yun-Sang Choi
pmc-12546692.description: 1Chitosan—a biopolymer produced by the deacetylation of chitin—finds numerous applications and is primarily obtained from the byproducts of marine crustacean processing. Given that this production method has numerous limitations, edible insects have drawn considerable attention as an alternative chitosan source.

pmc-12573227.title: A Concave Nanogap for Ultrasensitive Aptamer-Based SERS Detection and In Situ Imaging of Heavy Metal Ions
pmc-12573227.creator: Ting Wang, Feiya Sheng, Sijia Wu, Yifei Mao, Juewen Liu, Peng Li, Jinchao Wei
pmc-12573227.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Heavy metal pollution can lead to irreversible damage to human health. Surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) platforms are versatile for toxicity monitoring and in situ imaging, but they are often limited by false positives. In this study, we proposed the use of concave-facet nanocubes (CF NCs) to create sufficiently large nanogaps, which can be used for the deposition of probes such as aptamers. Aptamers adopt an extended configuration within these nanogaps, effectively preventing compression-induced false signals.

pmc-12831491.title: Boutonniere Deformity of the Proximal Interphalangeal Joint in a Young, Active Female Patient: A Nonstandard Surgical Procedure
pmc-12831491.creator: Jakub Florek, Oles Petrovych, Filip Georgiew, Patryk Kawa, Sebastian Janowiec
pmc-12831491.description: One of the key elements of post-traumatic osteoarthritis treatment is not only pain relief but also the return of joint function close to pre-injury levels. This is particularly important for young and physically active individuals. Unfortunately, the ability to return to satisfactory proximal intraphalangeal joint mobility after surgical treatment is often limited.

pmc-13374250.title: Available data sources to estimate adolescent birthrates in Mexico: a users’ guide
pmc-13374250.creator: Blair G Darney, Evelyn Fuentes-Rivera, Raffaela Schiavon, Gabriela Mejia-Pailles, Fernando Riosmena
pmc-13374250.description: BackgroundResearch, policymakers, and advocacy groups rely on valid estimates of adolescent births to inform their work. Estimates of births among very young adolescents (10–14 years old) are especially lacking.MethodsWe compared adolescent fertility rates in Mexico across the census, population-based surveys, civil registration, and birth certificates.
